testSummary.note: Cumulative across V4.1-V5.6. V5.6 added 80 new tests across 11 suites (MGCP-MGCK).

supportedClaims: Nm is a branch suppressor operating through a d-space mechanism.
Nm acts almost exclusively in d-space; K, Omega, and lambda1(K) are unchanged immediately by Nm.
Direct d-space intervention reproduces Nm-like suppression: d_mean shift alone eliminates V1 high-branch (12->0/30).
d_mean dose-response is monotonic and threshold-like: 10% dose halves high-branch, 25% reaches B0-level, 40% eliminates.
The RecoverFP branch outcome is governed by d-state entering Cupd through K=K0*exp(-d/xi).
Two symmetric operator pathways exist: Nm suppression (d-up -> K-down) and V9 amplification (d-down -> K-up).
V9 Double-Cupd amplifies high-branch through d-compression before the second Cupd.
K_mean mediates the Omega/branch response: d->K r=-0.998, K->Omega r=0.847.
d_mean before Cupd is the minimal suppressive coordinate.
The S2 resistant floor (9 seeds at N=67) is fully suppressible: same d->K mechanism at extreme magnitude.
Nm is not required for branch generation; the minimal RecoverFP map is Sm->RP->DL->Cupd (4 stages).
RP is strictly necessary for branch generation.
d_max is a distributional marker, not a functional mechanism.
conditionalClaims: All results at N=67, N=69, N=72, seeds 0-29 (Stage 1) and 0-99 (Stage 2, LongRunning).
d_mean shift transfers across N=67,69,72 only with state-conditioned operator (d'=d+0.5*d_mean), not with fixed absolute shifts.
V9 amplification is conditionally explained by the same d->K mapping at extreme d-compression.
Stage order (DL before Cupd) is necessary; placement of interventions before Cupd2 is critical.
Results at V5.3 baseline regime (xi=1.75, K0=1.20, s=0.10).
All gate classifications conditional on tested N and seed ranges.
hypotheses: The d-to-K subloop (DL->Cupd) is the core generative mechanism; the full 5-stage map may be refinable to a reduced d-operator form.
d_mean before Cupd may serve as a universal control coordinate for branch generation in RecoverFP-like systems.
The Nm/V9 symmetric pathways suggest a general duality between d-compression (amplification) and d-expansion (suppression) in exponential coupling maps.
The S2 extreme component may represent a class of seeds where Cupd1 K-state produces near-complete d-collapse in the second pass.
notClaimed: mathematical proof of minimality or irreducibility
causation beyond measured RecoverFP operator effects
generalization beyond N=67,69,72 and tested seeds
